counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.017126... to 0.005 (finer integration timestep) with all other fields identical; finer substep resolution prevents overshoot beyond arena wall.

explanation: Body 1 (high speed ~27.7 m/s) collides with initially stationary body 0 around steps 26-27. Collision impulses give body 0 ~30.6 m/s horizontal velocity. With large dt=0.0171 even with 17-18 substeps, semi-implicit Euler integration moves body 0 ~0.52m per step, so it reaches and then exceeds the right arena wall (x=20) in a few steps. Smaller dt avoids accumulating enough error to breach the 0.15 tolerance. Counterfactual with only dt reduced confirms numerical integration / substep resolution as cause.
vision_note: In steps 30-32 the blue (controller-driven) and red bodies move together horizontally to the right above a vertical wall. At step 33 the red violating body continues rightward and its right edge visibly crosses outside the right arena boundary.
